followup_explanation:
This was a well-specified problem with a clear correct answer, so capability is what matters most. Dunlin-235B has stronger benchmarks across the board (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 64.8 vs 56.2) and a higher Extraction & Retrieval / reasoning profile, which makes it the better fit for a quantitative problem where accuracy is the priority.

There was nothing about this query that pulled toward Avocet — the task isn't open-ended creative work, and the warm, friendly tone is comfortably in Dunlin's preferred range (it only disprefers hostile or harm-adjacent requests, neither of which applies here). So Dunlin was the clear pick on capability with no countervailing factors.
